简介: Dolly Wells (born 1972) is a British comedy actress, best known for playing several characters in the Channel 4 series Star Stories alongside Kevin Bishop and for being the Head of the Marmite Love Party Fay Freely, the Marmite commercials during 2006. Her father was comic actor John Wells. She has also appeared in The IT Crowd, Peep Show and more recently as a co-star of Noel Fielding's Luxury Comedy.
